title: King Agrippa and Bernice Visit Festus
description: King Agrippa and Bernice come to Caesarea to greet Festus, who presents Paul's case to the king. Festus explains that the dispute concerns a certain Jesus who is dead, but whom Paul claims is alive. The next day, Paul is brought into the audience hall with great ceremony so that Festus can have something to write to the emperor after the hearing.
